verdict.rationale: SerpApi has no native natural-language interface: it is driven by structured API parameters. However, its official MCP server lets MCP-compatible agents (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor) call SerpApi as a search tool, so users can operate it in natural language through a third-party agent. Missing for 10: a first-party natural-language interface without an external agent, documentation of which operations are exposed through MCP and how well they work, and independent hands-on corroboration of natural-language operation.
